definitions.explanation: A tall, raised pillow. The literal meaning, much less common in everyday speech than the idiomatic use.

definitions.gloss: sleeping in peace; resting easy; freedom from worry
definitions.explanation: An idiom meaning to sleep soundly and without anxiety, by extension to be free of worry. Used especially in the expression {高枕|たかまくら}で{寝|ね}る/{眠|ねむ}る.

examples.japanese: {高枕|たかまくら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高枕|たかまくら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だった。
examples.english: High pillows used to be common in the old days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{高枕|たかまくら}⟦でないと→でないと：30684_denaito⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather still can't sleep without a high pillow.

examples.japanese: {高枕|たかまくら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}られる→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{高枕|たかまくら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れる→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: Now that work is done, I can finally sleep easy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}し→返す：09648_kaesu⟧{終|お}わる⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{高枕|たかまくら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: Until I finish paying off the debt, I can hardly sleep in peace.

notes:
Literally "high pillow." The idiomatic sense comes from the historical idea that one can only afford a comfortable, raised pillow when one has nothing to fear or be vigilant about.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高枕|たかまくら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to sleep without worry
- {高枕|たかまくら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧: to sleep soundly
- {高枕|たかまくら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かく: to rest easy, take it easy (set phrase)

USAGE:
The figurative sense is far more common in modern Japanese. Often appears in negative form ({高枕|たかまくら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寝|ね}られない→寝る：00470_neru⟧) to express ongoing anxiety.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{安眠|あんみん}→安眠：12266_anmin⟧: peaceful sleep — focuses on sleep quality itself
- ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to sleep with the pillow high — same idiom expanded out, common phrasing
